description: datastash: inbox count at session start; a background inbox listener that wakes the session when messages arrive; the person's typed "datastash main" makes that session the person's main session; the person's typed status phrases ("status", "status of all my agents", "full context of N", one bounded screen, then "more of N") are answered by the plugin itself from this computer's copy when keeping is on (no model turn, no network); the person's typed answers to that list ("do N", "no to N", "N: text") are sent by the plugin itself, only after the transcript shows them as typed by the person, with a one-time proof signed by the login's answer key; the answer key, its file and the typed checker are denied to tool calls like the login token; any tool call that could carry datastash content (a datastash connector by name or URL, the datastash command or its files, a fetch from getdatastash.com, or anything it can't tell) records the session as an agent, which can never become main; at the end of a turn that used tools, an agent whose work changed (commits, changed files, a test run, a new ask) and whose status line was not updated is asked once to write it: at most every 10 minutes, only for a project that is kept, never while datastash has no status door, never looping; after a Bash call, a repeated lookup to an outside tool (gh PRs and CI, Linear, Jira, Sentry) is counted by its command shape only, and once datastash keeps that answer the agent gets one line saying where it is; the background listener also keeps a project map of each linked git folder, in plain code, mapped again only after a commit, for `datastash where` and `datastash file`; clean sessions (the person's own choices for all their agents): the session start gives the rules only for what is on, XLI-396: while either choice is on, the main session (no agent_id in the hook input) runs only the tools that can't change a file or run code (deny by default: Read, Grep, Glob, Agent, SendMessage, TaskStop, ListAgents, ReadNotifications, ToolSearch, AskUserQuestion, WebFetch, WebSearch, the datastash connector's read-only tools and the plugin's own steps), and every tool that runs a command (Bash, Monitor, any command) only as one short read-only lookup (plain words and quoted literals only, no shell metacharacter, glob or brace, each command's own option list) or a read of the plugin's own datastash command (a Monitor also datastash watch); anything else, unknown tools and MCP writes included, is refused with one fixed line, and a subagent is never refused, and the person's typed "no code in sessions", "turn off clean sessions" or "turn on clean sessions" is saved by the plugin. XLI-375: the listener says hello to datastash on every start (tried again with a growing wait), with the cause codes of anything in this computer's own settings that stops datastash; the session start tells the person once per cause, with the exact settings line or terminal command; the person's typed "turn off the standing yes" or "turn on the standing yes" is saved by the plugin. XLI-390: at most once a day, in the background at session start, the plugin checks the plugin repo for a newer release tag (never a branch head) and, when the refreshed marketplace catalog pins exactly that tag's commit, updates itself with Claude Code's own `claude plugin update`; the next session start says "datastash updated to vX" once; the person's typed "turn off self-update" or "turn on self-update" is saved by the plugin, and while it is off there is no check and no update. XLI-390 P1: the person's typed /datastash:install (always all agents) and /datastash:uninstall (the list, then names or all) are done by the plugin itself: the key is collected with a verifier that never leaves this computer, notes to other agents carry a typed proof, an uninstall cleans up only the plugin's own fixed paths, and an agent removed elsewhere cleans up on its own key's 410; the hooks never start a datastash login. XLI-390 X6: the person's typed "make <name> private" or "make <name> public" (the whole prompt) is sent by the plugin as a typed-proof note over the agent id from the list, and the plugin shows datastash's fixed line. XLI-374 (11-24): every message wakes the agent by itself: a session whose agent another session still listens for waits beside it and takes over when that one lets go (a restarted session), the listener starts over after any fault it does not know, and the idle notice (Notification idle_prompt) starts the listener again when a turn ended with no Stop hook. XLI-391: at every session start, and when the listener sees it change, the plugin states the person's chatstash setting (on or off, who set it and when) as a datastash note; it holds this chat's chat_key itself (mode 600), adds it to the connector's chat_save calls and takes it out of datastash answers, so the model never sees it.
